newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Handelsbanken rides high on lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Handelsbanken rides high on lower rates.

text.p: Sweden's top commercial bank, Svenska Handelsbanken, Tuesday posted a 19 percent rise in earnings for the first nine months of the year, saying the boost was due to higher income from commissions and improved interest earnings.
Handelsbanken's profit after loan losses increased to 4.52 billion crowns ($689 million) from the 3.79 billion ($578 million) for the first nine months of last year.
Loan losses were down 30 percent to 1.24 billion crowns ($189 million).

Earnings before loan losses showed a less dramatic improvement, but were nonetheless a respectable 5.83 billion crowns ($889 million), compared with the 5.56 billion ($848 million) reported for the corresponding 1995 period.
This in turn was the result of an improved interest earnings and a healthy 19 percent rise in income from commissions, mainly on Handelsbanken's investment banking services.
